Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to extract the specific information requested (the mother's death location) from the initial search results. While the search results clearly identified the mother as "Princess Mathilde Sophie of Oettingen-Oettingen and Oettingen-Spielberg," the visible text in the viewport did not contain her death location. Instead of reporting that the information was missing and suggesting a more targeted search, the agent prematurely concluded the search phase and passed the incomplete data to the Planner. This led to a cycle of redundant searches where the agent repeatedly retrieved the same ambiguous snippets without ever successfully extracting the definitive death location from a reliable source in the initial steps.
